messages:
emma_docs: Quick sync — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3427 for the SDK snippets + migration note. Can someone review? Netlify preview claims success but the screenshots for the migration guide are 404ing.

noah_reviewer: On it. I can take the snippets review now. Do you know which image path is failing?

emma_docs: looks like /assets/migration/arch-diagram.png is missing from the build artifact. Local build shows it fine which makes me think preview deploy is pruning large files.

sam_engineer: FYI CI had a flaky step earlier that killed a few Netlify deploys — deploy-bot logged `build skipped: cached artifact mismatch`. Might be related.

deploy-bot: deploy status for branch emma/docs-sdk-snippets: build started -> failed -> retry queued. Logs: "Warning: asset too large, storing in external cache" at step: artifact-collector.

noah_reviewer: If the preview is flaky, can we get a manual Netlify deploy for this branch? I need the images to verify the migration example.

emma_docs: I can trigger it but Netlify UI times out for larger uploads. Sam, could you try the manual curl deploy command?

sam_engineer: Sure — using the Netlify deploy-cli worked for me earlier:
```
netlify deploy --dir=build/_site --message="PR 3427 manual preview" --prod=false
```
But if the artifact collector is trimming files on CI, the local `build/_site` should have the images.

maria_pm: Heads-up: product wants the migration guide merged before Friday morning (PST). If reviewers approve, can we schedule the merge during off-peak to avoid the CI flakiness window?

noah_reviewer: I can finish the review in 30 mins. If everything is green, merge window that Maria mentioned works for me. Could we add a short checklist to the PR so QA doesn't miss the image paths?

emma_docs: good call. Added a checklist to the PR: 1) confirm images load on Netlify preview, 2) run `yarn docs:preview` locally and check /migration, 3) run linter on code fences.

sam_engineer: Also adding a temporary CI override label `ci:skip-artifact-prune` to the branch might prevent the artifact collector from trimming for this PR. I'll add it and re-run.

deploy-bot: build re-run triggered by sam_engineer with label ci:skip-artifact-prune. New status: queued -> success.

emma_docs: Netlify preview is back and images load. Thanks Sam! Noah — once you finish the review I can squash and merge in the Friday off-peak window.

noah_reviewer: Reviewed, left two tiny comments about the SDK snippet formatting. Nothing blocking. Approving after those are addressed.

emma_docs: Addressed both comments and pushed. Ready for merge.

maria_pm: Confirmed timeline with stakeholders. Merge at 02:00 UTC Friday is fine. Please also add a note in the release notes about the migration doc update.

sam_engineer: Small reminder for future: local preview command we use is
```
# from repo root
yarn install
yarn docs:preview
# then open http://localhost:3000/migration
```
Include that in the PR template? saves a round trip.

emma_docs: adding local preview snippet to PR template now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

noah_reviewer: Approved and leaving final ack.

emma_docs: Merged at 1763460320 (off-peak). Tagging release notes. Closing thread. :party_popper:
